explanation: Fixed two defects identified in the test suite: (1) In `_Lexer.parse_encapsulated_token` and `parse_simple_token`, appending the multi-char or single-char delimiter string used `token.content.append(self.delimiter)` which appended a string to a list of characters rather than characters (`extend`), causing type mismatches; (2) Added explicit validation for boolean configuration settings (`trim`, `ignore_empty_lines`, `ignore_surrounding_spaces`, `trailing_delimiter`) to reject non-boolean inputs with an `IllegalArgumentException` as expected by Java/Python typed validation.
